text:
jordan: Heads-up — customer acct=5821 getting 400 from /v1/functions/invoke. Error from our API: "schema validation failed: required property 'session_id' missing; additionalProperties ['promo_code'] not allowed". Happened on hosted region eu-west-1, sdk-js v0.9.2. Customer says it worked yesterday. Repro steps below.

megan: Can you paste the exact payload they sent and the raw error (including correlation id)?

jordan: Payload they sent:
```json
{
  "user_id": 9876,
  "action": "create_order",
  "promo_code": "SPRING10",
  "amount": "1200"
}
```
Raw error snippet from our gateway: 
```
400 Bad Request - ValidationError
{"message":"required property 'session_id' missing","schemaPath":"#/required"}
{"message":"additional property 'promo_code' is not allowed","schemaPath":"#/additionalProperties"}
```

samir: Thanks — correlation id is cid=ci-9f8b2a. I see three attempts at 2026-03-15T14:12:09Z from the customer's IP. Logs show request hit runtime v2.4.1 and was rejected by the function argument validator before execution.

ryan: This looks like two separate failure modes: (1) strict required fields — older clients used to send session_id from SDK middleware; (2) we validate against function schema with additionalProperties=false so any extra keys (promo_code) fail. Both can block customers.

m egan: (typo fix) megan: For immediate unblock — can we suggest customer remove promo_code and include session_id? Or should we relax schema to accept promo_code as a safe unknown field?

ryan: Short term: tell customer to include session_id (we can provide a shim) and drop promo_code. Medium: engineering options — a) accept additionalProperties and drop unknown keys into ctx.meta by default, b) coerce numeric-looking strings to ints for amount, c) add compatibility mode flag on the runtime to tolerate extra props.

jordan: Customer is asking for a faster patch — their checkout is blocked in prod. They prefer we accept promo_code as passthrough (they use it only for analytics). Requested ETA?

ryan: I can take a quick patch to the validation layer to allow additionalProperties for function schemas under a compatibility toggle. If QA signs off we can roll a canary tonight. Will need eng-runtime + eng-ml signoff for no regressions.

support-bot: Escalation created: #escalations/2411123581 (priority:P1) — assign eng-runtime + devex to provide compatibility shim.

megan: Jordan — please relay this to the customer: 1) temporary workaround: remove promo_code and include session_id in payload, 2) we are rolling a compatibility toggle canary tonight and will follow up with CI link and canary id. Also ask them to send any SDK version info and whether their client library strips session_id now.

jordan: Will do. Attaching customer's contact and permission to test on their account. Thanks all. :pray:
